summary: SaaS Multi-tenant system for Evoke OS tested successfully. All backend API endpoints working (15/15 tests passed). Frontend UI components (Billing, Team, Onboarding) verified working correctly.

issues: React warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement needed

GET_api_org_plans.details: Returns 3 plans (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) with correct limits and features. Starter is free ($0), Professional is highlighted.

GET_api_org_billing.details: Returns subscription info, plan details, payment method (STUBBED), and billing invoices. Auto-creates Starter plan subscription for users without one.

GET_api_org_usage.details: Returns current month usage metrics (events_created, active_users, proposals_created, supplier_invoices) and plan limits with warnings at 80%+ usage.

GET_api_org_members.details: Returns team members list with user details, roles, and is_current_user flag.

POST_api_org_invitations.details: Creates team invitation with email, role, token, and 7-day expiry. Validates email format and checks for duplicates.

settings_billing_tab.details: Shows Current Plan (Starter), Price ($0/mo), Cycle (Monthly), Next Renewal date, Status (Active), Change Plan button, and Monthly Usage bars for Events (0/5), Users (0/2), Proposals (0/10), Invoices (0/20).

settings_team_tab.details: Shows Team Members (0 active members) with Invite button. Invite dialog has Email input, Role selector (Admin, Operations, Finance, Viewer), Cancel and Send Invitation buttons.

onboarding_page.details: Shows 5-step wizard: Organization (name, currency, timezone, billing email), Plan (3 plans with monthly/yearly toggle), Billing (Stripe stub), Team (invite members), Done. All steps navigable.

change_plan_dialog.details: Shows all 3 plans with pricing, limits, and Upgrade buttons. Current plan marked with 'Current' badge.

usage_limits_enforcement.details: GET /api/org/usage/check/{metric} returns allowed status and percentage. Limits enforced on invitation creation.

critical_code_review_comments: DialogContent in TeamSection.js missing DialogDescription for accessibility - add aria-describedby or DialogDescription component
Console shows 'Failed to fetch inventory: AxiosError' on dashboard - unrelated to SaaS feature but indicates inventory endpoint may have issues
context_for_next_testing_agent: SaaS Multi-tenant system fully implemented and working. Plans are initialized on startup from DEFAULT_PLANS constant. Default Starter plan auto-created for users without subscription. Legacy users (without membership) get owner permissions. OrgSwitcher only shows if user belongs to multiple organizations. Stripe integration is STUBBED - payment methods and checkout are simulated.

billing_endpoint.auto_creates: Starter plan subscription if none exists

usage_endpoint.returns: period, metrics (events_created, active_users, proposals_created, supplier_invoices), limits, warnings

members_endpoint.returns: List of team members with membership_id, user_id, email, name, picture, role, joined_at, is_current_user

invitations_endpoint.returns: invitation_id, company_id, email, role, token, expires_at, status

org_switcher.location: Sidebar (only if user has multiple orgs)
